mcqs.question: According to The Lancet Public Health study, how many deaths in India were attributed to second-hand smoke in 2023?
mcqs.explanation: The Lancet Public Health reported 3,25,600 second-hand smoke deaths in India in 2023, up from 2,17,700 in 1990. The figure of 4,44,000 refers to India’s exposed population in millions, while 7,67,000 refers to exposed children globally.
